sections.heading: NEET Document Specifications.
body: The National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) requires candidates to upload several documents in PDF format: Category certificates, PwBD certificates, Citizenship certificates, and Class 10 certificates.
The size range for these scanned PDF files must be between 50 KB and 300 KB. It is critical that all details, such as school names, marks, and official stamp details remain legible.
If a file is blurry or illegible, it may cause problems during online document verification, potentially halting your application progress.

faq.q: What is the PDF size limit for NEET certificates?
faq.a: NEET certificate PDFs (Category, PwBD, Citizenship, Class 10) must be between 50 KB and 300 KB.

faq.q: Which documents must be uploaded in PDF format for NEET?
faq.a: NTA (National Testing Agency) requires the Class 10 Pass Certificate, Category Certificate (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS), PwBD Certificate, and Citizenship Certificate to be uploaded strictly as PDF files.

faq.q: What happens if my NEET Class 10 certificate is below 50 KB?
faq.a: NTA's system will display an error if the uploaded PDF is less than 50 KB or greater than 300 KB. Our compressor allows you to select a custom target size like 150 KB or 250 KB, staying safely inside the valid 50 KB to 300 KB bracket.

faq.q: Can I compress a mobile scanner scan of my NEET certificate?
faq.a: Yes, mobile scanner apps (like Adobe Scan or CamScanner) usually produce PDFs around 2 MB to 5 MB. Zcompressor shrinks these scanned PDFs down to 100-250 KB directly on your smartphone without losing essential legibility.

faq.q: Does Zcompressor store my NEET documents or Aadhaar details?
faq.a: No, absolutely not. Zcompressor runs 100% locally inside your web browser. No server uploads occur, ensuring your marksheets, identity cards, and personal records remain private.
